nodes.description: Hardcoded EOG token contract address used as external token interface (EIP20Interface).
Contract owner address; set in constructor and changed by transferOwnership, gates onlyOwner functions.
Public address storing the last paid max-holder winner in StartLottery.
Public address storing the last lottery winner paid in StartLottery.
Minimum EOG balance required to register and to be counted in the lottery (5e18 default).
Private pseudo-random seed written by ChangeMinEog and read by Random.
Public ETH amount overwritten on every chargeLottery call with msg.value.
Private array of payable participant addresses pushed in Register and iterated over in lottery logic.
Constructor sets owner from msg.sender.
onlyOwner external function that reassigns the owner address to an arbitrary new owner.
External view that scans Competitors and returns the EOG balance of a registered address, else 0.
onlyOwner external function that rewrites MinEOG and the private seed.
View function summing EOG balances (scaled by 1e13) of competitors above MinEOG into Maxrand.
Public payable function that overwrites ChargedETH with msg.value.
View pseudo-random generator using block.timestamp, block.difficulty, Competitors.length and seed.
View returning the competitor with the highest EOG balance; indexes Competitors[0] without emptiness check.
onlyOwner lottery draw that selects a winner from weighted balances and sends ETH to winner and max holder.
Internal view scanning Competitors to check whether an address is already registered.
Public function requiring msg.sender to hold at least MinEOG and be not yet registered, then pushes msg.sender to Competitors.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, access control and competitor registration.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as randomness entropy inside Random.
Competitors[i].transfer((address(this).balance/4)*3) sends ETH to an arbitrary participant address inside StartLottery.
MaxHold.transfer(address(this).balance) drains the whole contract balance to the max holder inside StartLottery.
ChargedETH is blindly overwritten with the latest msg.value instead of being accumulated, losing prior contributions.
Randomness derived from block.timestamp/block.difficulty is predictable and miner-influenceable.
GetMaxHolder reads Competitors[0] with no length check; reverts when no competitor is registered.
Maxrand += balanceOf(...)/(10**13) accumulation under Solidity 0.5 is unchecked and can overflow.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership, the new owner address.
Parameter _adr of GetUserPoints, the address whose points are queried.
Parameter _newval of ChangeMinEog, the new MinEOG threshold.
Parameter _seed of ChangeMinEog, the new randomness seed.
Parameter max of Random, the modulo bound for the drawn number.
Parameter _adr of ExistCompetitor, the address looked up in Competitors.
Loop index i iterating over Competitors inside GetUserPoints.
Loop index i iterating over Competitors inside GetPoints.
Loop index i iterating over Competitors inside GetMaxHolder.
Loop index i iterating over Competitors inside StartLottery.
Loop index i iterating over Competitors inside ExistCompetitor.
Accumulator Maxrand (total weighted points) in GetPoints.
Derived random value randomnumber in Random.
Running max holder address MaxHolder in GetMaxHolder.
Drawn lottery number RandNum used for winner selection in StartLottery.
Rolling weight counter used to locate the winning interval in StartLottery.
Per-competitor weighted share tempnum in StartLottery.
Address returned by GetMaxHolder and paid in StartLottery.

edges.reason: Constructor writes owner state variable from the deployer.
msg.sender is read by the constructor to establish contract ownership.
transferOwnership rewrites the owner state variable.
onlyOwner check compares msg.sender with owner before transferring ownership.
onlyOwner modifier reads owner to authorize transferOwnership.
onlyOwner check compares msg.sender with owner before changing MinEOG and seed.
onlyOwner modifier reads owner to authorize ChangeMinEog.
ChangeMinEog writes the MinEOG threshold.
ChangeMinEog writes the private randomness seed.
onlyOwner check compares msg.sender with owner before starting the lottery.
onlyOwner modifier reads owner to authorize StartLottery.
chargeLottery assigns msg.value into the ChargedETH state variable.
chargeLottery performs the unsafe ChargedETH overwrite instead of accumulating.
Random consumes block.timestamp as entropy (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp feeds the weak randomness unsafe operation.
Random computes a predictable number from timestamp/difficulty.
Random reads the private seed state variable.
Random reads Competitors.length as randomness entropy.
GetPoints result is passed as the max bound into Random.
StartLottery calls Random to draw the winning number.
StartLottery calls GetPoints to compute the total weight.
GetPoints queries the EOG token via EOGAddress.
GetPoints iterates over the Competitors array.
GetPoints performs unchecked accumulation of weighted balances.
StartLottery sends ETH to a competitor address via transfer.
StartLottery sends the whole contract balance to the max holder.
ETH transfer to an address stored in Competitors executes recipient code (limited gas callback).
Control returns from the recipient transfer back into StartLottery.
Control returns from the max-holder transfer back into StartLottery.
StartLottery calls GetMaxHolder to determine the max holder payout.
GetMaxHolder queries token balances through EOGAddress.
GetMaxHolder iterates over the Competitors array.
GetMaxHolder performs the unchecked Competitors[0] index read.
StartLottery writes LastLotteryWinner after paying.
StartLottery writes LastMaxWinner after paying.
StartLottery reads balances of addresses stored in Competitors.
Register pushes msg.sender into the Competitors array.
Register queries the EOG token balance through EOGAddress.
Register requires the caller balance to be at least MinEOG.
Register uses msg.sender as the participant identity and registration argument.
Register calls ExistCompetitor to reject duplicate registrations.
ExistCompetitor scans the Competitors array.
GetUserPoints reads token balances through EOGAddress.
GetUserPoints iterates over the Competitors array.
StartLottery reads LastMaxWinner to avoid paying the same max holder twice in a row.
StartLottery reads LastLotteryWinner to avoid paying the same lottery winner twice in a row.
GetPoints uses MinEOG to filter eligible competitors.
Register uses MinEOG as the registration threshold.

normalization_plan.reason: The new owner parameter only flows into the owner state write inside transferOwnership and has no independent identity.
The queried address parameter is only consumed by the Competitors scan in GetUserPoints.
The threshold parameter only feeds the MinEOG write in ChangeMinEog.
The seed parameter only feeds the seed state write in ChangeMinEog.
The modulo bound parameter is only used inside the Random computation.
The lookup address parameter is only consumed by the Competitors scan in ExistCompetitor.
Loop index is a function-scoped iteration variable of GetUserPoints.
Loop index is a function-scoped iteration variable of GetPoints.
Loop index is a function-scoped iteration variable of GetMaxHolder.
Loop index is a function-scoped iteration variable of StartLottery.
Loop index is a function-scoped iteration variable of ExistCompetitor.
Maxrand is the internal accumulator of GetPoints and drives its return value.
randomnumber is the transient computed value of Random and never leaves the function.
MaxHolder is the running maximum tracked and returned by GetMaxHolder.
RandNum is the drawn number used only for winner selection inside StartLottery.
counter is the weighted interval accumulator used only inside StartLottery.
tempnum is a per-iteration weighted share used only inside StartLottery.
MaxHold is the payout target returned by GetMaxHolder and used directly in the max-holder transfer.
